Drug researchers and medical laboratories generate massive volumes of biological data every single day, yet somehow the artificial intelligence models designed to speed up drug discovery are still starved of useful information. It’s a strange paradox, but a startup called Tesorai Inc. believes it has the solution after raising $5.3 million in seed funding today. […]

The post Tesorai raises $5.3M to feed starving AI models with biological data and accelerate drug discovery appeared first on SiliconANGLE.
